Develop respect for community leaders Follow health rules at home and at school.

Demonstrate obedience to the rule of law The Pledge of Allegiance The Lone Star Song The Seal of Liberia Basic Civics Mixed Group Work: Read lines from your Civics book and discuss attitudes that are patriotic and attitudes that are unpatriotic Drama: Dramatize a situation in which you are helping an elderly person who is sick at their home Online civics resource Links www.brainpop.com www.socialstudiesforkids.com www.primarygames.com www.pbskids.org www.learninggames.com www.dictionary.com www.khanacademy.com

findings.evidence: 9 of 9 instructional sections are directions with no content, e.g. "This lesson teaches rules, rights, and duties with a clear sequence of explanation, examples, guided work, an…"
findings.issue: The lesson is a template shell: sections say what to teach ("Model one complete example…") but contain no explanation, example or item.
findings.proposedCorrection: Replace with a full candidate lesson (Track C); keep the legacy revision for history.

findings.issue: The same learner text is catalogued as more than one lesson.
findings.proposedCorrection: Choose one canonical lesson; map the others to it in the legacy mapping plan (never delete referenced rows).

findings.evidence: Flesch-Kincaid grade 12.3 for a grade 1 lesson
findings.issue: Sentence and word length suggest the text is harder to read than the grade allows.
findings.proposedCorrection: Shorten sentences and gloss vocabulary without lowering the conceptual demand; confirm with a language reviewer.

findings.issue: Instruction assumes prerequisites it never checks.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a short diagnostic per prerequisite with a stated route for learners who lack it.

findings.evidence: Worked Example 1: Model a short scenario related to rules, rights, and duties and explain the key idea in action. Worked Example 2: Compare…
findings.issue: Worked examples state answers without showing the reasoning steps.
findings.proposedCorrection: Show each step and why it is taken.

findings.issue: Common errors are neither taught against nor anticipated.
findings.proposedCorrection: Catalogue the objective's misconceptions and teach against each (Track A).

findings.evidence: no item carries response-specific feedback or a misconception-mapped distractor
findings.issue: Wrong answers cannot be diagnosed or corrected by cause.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each distractor or response pattern to a catalogued misconception with corrective feedback.

findings.evidence: no explain/justify/compare prompt in independent work or assessment
findings.issue: Learners are never asked to produce reasoning, only answers.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a constructed-response reasoning or performance task at scaffold NONE scored by a rubric.

findings.evidence: no assessment questions found in body or structured fields
findings.issue: Nothing checks whether learners met the objectives.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an independent end-of-lesson demonstration covering every objective.

findings.evidence: no delayed or spaced retrieval task
findings.issue: Nothing checks whether learning lasts beyond the lesson.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add a retention blueprint: retrieval items for each mastery objective at ≥7 days (LM-ASM-3).

findings.evidence: no task marked as a new context, representation or genre
findings.issue: Learners are only tested in rehearsed contexts, so transfer is unknown.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add an unscaffolded transfer task in a context the lesson did not rehearse (GE-TRN-1).

findings.evidence: CIVICS → MOE SOCIAL_STUDIES (24 objectives at grade 1). No MOE Civics document is in the verified archives; civic objectives sit inside MOE Social Studies.
findings.issue: Objectives can only be traced through a broader MOE subject (see evidence); that mapping is a curriculum-owner decision, not an MOE fact.
findings.proposedCorrection: Record the owner's decision to trace this subject through the named MOE subject before release; candidate work may proceed.

findings.issue: No objective is traced to the MOE curriculum.
findings.proposedCorrection: Map each objective to a structured MOE objective id with source page, reviewed by a curriculum owner; lexical leads are attached to this audit.
